weights: All 1; no normalization or cognitive weighted index
extraQuestions: None in selected standalone form; no impairment, attention or safety-screening items inserted.

missingPolicy.rule: Missing symptom -> no total. No imputation/proration/blank-to-zero. May skip or leave; no forced disclosure.

invalidPolicy: Reject strings including numeric strings, booleans, fractions, out-of-range, explicit null answers, arrays and duplicate responses. Missing means no submitted answer.
report: Only total/21 with descriptive limitations. No clinical band, screen-positive label, diagnosis, norm, percentile, treatment-response or suicide-risk inference.
